outcome_definition: Outcome = the size of one melting-curve class in the 2-SNP assay (74 bp amplicon, rs547832288 + rs16906252). The paper reports the class SIZES only ('six groups containing two, two groups containing three, three groups containing four, and one group containing five'), not a control-to-class assignment; n_controls = size x n_classes.
